description: This file defines synchronization primitives such as CriticalSection, BinairySemaphore, CountingSemaphore, and Event within the WPEFramework::Core namespace. It includes class declarations, method signatures, and platform-specific synchronization mechanisms, serving as a core synchronization utility header for the project.

classes.name: CriticalSection
classes.description: A class providing mutual exclusion via platform-specific mutexes or critical sections.

classes.name: BinairySemaphore
classes.description: A semaphore allowing binary (locked/unlocked) state management.

classes.name: CountingSemaphore
classes.description: A semaphore managing a count-based resource limit.

classes.name: Event
classes.description: A synchronization event object supporting manual or automatic reset.

classes.name: SafeSyncType
classes.description: A template class providing RAII-style locking for synchronization objects.
